title: Tribal Healthcare Encounter
description: Schema for Indian Health Service (IHS) tribal healthcare encounter data. Covers outpatient, inpatient, emergency, telehealth, dental, behavioral health, pharmacy, and laboratory encounters across IHS facilities, service units, and area offices.

patient_id.description: De-identified patient identifier in format PAT-XXXXXXXX

facility_name.description: Name of the IHS or tribal health center facility

encounter_date.description: Date and time of the encounter in ISO 8601 format

icd10_description.description: Human-readable description of the ICD-10 diagnosis code

cpt_description.description: Human-readable description of the CPT procedure code

provider_type.description: Type or role of the healthcare provider

tribal_affiliation.description: Name of the federally recognized tribe the patient is affiliated with

service_unit.description: IHS Service Unit responsible for the facility

area_office.description: IHS Area Office that administers the service unit

insurance_type.description: Primary insurance or payment type for the encounter

medication_name.description: Name of prescribed or dispensed medication

lab_test_name.description: Name of the laboratory test performed

lab_result_value.description: Numeric result value of the laboratory test

lab_result_unit.description: Unit of measurement for the laboratory result

lab_abnormal_flag.description: Abnormal flag for laboratory result (N=Normal, L=Low, H=High, LL=Critically Low, HH=Critically High)

hipaa_consent.description: Whether HIPAA consent has been obtained (always true for generated data)

phi_masked.description: Whether Protected Health Information has been masked (always true for generated data)

load_time.description: Timestamp when the record was loaded/generated in ISO 8601 format
